description: Trim an audio file starting at the given second, optionally for the given duration in seconds.

duration.description: Optional length in seconds of the trimmed output; when omitted, audio runs from start to the end of the file.

input.description: Path to the input audio file to trim.

output.description: Path to write the trimmed audio file to.

start.description: Start time in seconds from which to trim the audio.

name: trim_audio
